how_sent: Zero-shot, manual. A new ChatGPT conversation got the text of baselines/llm/prompt.txt as the whole instruction and baselines/llm/items.jsonl (50 test conversations, no labels) in one message. No labeled conversation was included. The reply is saved unedited in baselines/llm/raw_responses.jsonl and converted to baselines/llm/predictions.csv.
reproducibility: Manual chat run. Temperature and the exact model snapshot are not visible in the ChatGPT interface, so a rerun may differ.
previous_run: Grok 4.7, recorded in run_grok.json and predictions_grok.csv (macro F1 0.404).
leaderboard: Scored on 50 of the 101 test conversations. The 50 were drawn from the six-annotator test set, which the frozen split keeps entirely in test, and were rescored against the seven-annotator labels. This file is not a full-test leaderboard submission.
